_instructions: Single run record to append to past_runs.csv. Field names below are canonical; map them onto the existing CSV column names rather than adding new columns where an equivalent already exists. Fields with null are genuine data gaps, not zeros.
_grade_note: Deliberately ungraded. A field test is a measurement, not a session to score against pace/HR targets — grading it would pollute the grade trend.
exclude_reason: Activity started cold with no warm-up (HR 80 bpm at t=0). Whole-run EF is distorted by the ramp and is not comparable to steady Z2 sessions.

test_result.protocol: 30-min field test, average HR of final 20 min
test_result.lap_structure: Manual lap press at 10:05 and 30:06; laps 3-6 together form the measurement window

notes: Pace faded 5:05 -> 5:22 across the window while HR climbed to 179 — effort sat at or just above threshold, which is what a valid test should look like. Logged Feel as 'Very Weak' at only RPE 5/10; flag if this recurs, since it may indicate the HR reading was elevated by fatigue or illness rather than by effort.
